These slide decks accompany the [IMAG Teaching Materials](../teaching/index.html) and are designed for six Master's-level sessions following the round-by-round investment decision flow. Each deck is self-contained and maps directly to the corresponding chapters of the handbook and stations of the [IMAG Allocation App](https://inno.uni.li/apps/invest/).

| Lesson | Slide Deck | Handbook Chapters | App Station | Key Simulation Deliverable |
|:--:|:--|:--|:--:|:--|
| **Lesson 1** | [A Round in IMAG — Introduction & Simulation Setup](01_introduction.html) | [Ch. 1: A round in IMAG](../teaching/01_round.html) | Overview | Explore Cesim Invest & the app; establish team governance |
| **Lesson 2** | [Reading the Client — Client Analysis & Risk Aversion](02_clients.html) | [Ch. 2: Reading the client](../teaching/02_client.html) | Input to St. 2 | Bracket $\gamma$ from past choices; record one client specification line per fund |
| **Lesson 3** | [Reading the Market — Strategic Asset Analysis](03_market.html) | [Ch. 3: Reading the market](../teaching/03_market.html) | Station 1 | Analyse Sharpe ratios, unhedged USD currency risk & defensive correlations |
| **Lesson 4** | [Setting the Strategic Allocation — SAA](04_saa.html) | [Ch. 4: Setting the strategic allocation](../teaching/04_saa.html) | Station 2 | Optimise, check & fix each fund's SAA benchmark; save JSON & enter in game |
| **Lesson 5** | [From Views to Tactical Allocation — Views, TAA & Securities](05_taa.html) | [Ch. 5](../teaching/05_views.html), [Ch. 6](../teaching/06_taa.html) & [Ch. 7](../teaching/07_securities.html) | Stations 3 & 4 | Diagnose the Investment Clock, form Black–Litterman views, set TAA & ESG floor |
| **Lesson 6** | [Submit, Measure and Learn — Fees, Results & Feedback](06_results.html) | [Ch. 8](../teaching/08_submit.html) & [Ch. 9](../teaching/09_results.html) | Feedback to St. 2–4 | Set fees, verify Projections, submit Team Area, and run Micro Attribution review |
